'''2012 European Championship Rich Jennings LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Rich Jennings]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
